scripts.start:web: cross-env BROWSER=none HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=2907 react-scripts start
scripts.build: npm run version:prepare-build && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web
scripts.build:unchain:raw: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run mcp-runtime:prepare && bash ./unchain_runtime/scripts/build_unchain_server.sh
scripts.build:unchain:mac:raw: npm run version:prepare-build && node ./scripts/prepare-mcp-runtime.cjs --target darwin-arm64 && UNCHAIN_TARGET_ARCH=arm64 bash ./unchain_runtime/scripts/build_unchain_server.sh macos
scripts.build:unchain:mac:intel:raw: npm run version:prepare-build && node ./scripts/prepare-mcp-runtime.cjs --target darwin-x64 && UNCHAIN_TARGET_ARCH=x86_64 bash ./unchain_runtime/scripts/build_unchain_server.sh macos
scripts.build:unchain:linux:raw: npm run version:prepare-build && node ./scripts/prepare-mcp-runtime.cjs --target linux-x64 && bash ./unchain_runtime/scripts/build_unchain_server.sh linux
scripts.build:unchain:win:raw: npm run version:prepare-build && node ./scripts/prepare-mcp-runtime.cjs --target win32-x64 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./unchain_runtime/scripts/build_unchain_server.ps1 windows
scripts.build:electron: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.build:electron:mac: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain:mac && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:electron:mac:unsigned: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain:mac && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.build:electron:mac:release: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain:mac && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.build:electron:mac:intel: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain:mac:intel && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:electron:mac:intel:unsigned: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain:mac:intel && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.build:electron:mac:intel:release: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain:mac:intel && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.build:win:chain: npm run build:unchain:win && npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:chain:unsigned: npm run build:unchain:win && npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config.win.verifyUpdateCodeSignature=false
scripts.build:win:chain:unpacked: npm run build:unchain:win && npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never --config.win.verifyUpdateCodeSignature=false
scripts.build:electron:win: npm run version:prepare-build && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:win:chain
scripts.build:electron:win:unsigned: npm run version:prepare-build && cross-env WIN_CSC_LINK= CSC_LINK= WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:win:chain:unsigned
scripts.build:electron:win:unpacked: npm run version:prepare-build && cross-env WIN_CSC_LINK= CSC_LINK= WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:win:chain:unpacked
scripts.build:electron:linux: npm run version:prepare-build && npm run build:unchain:linux && cross-env PUPU_VERSION_PREPARED=1 npm run build:web && npm run notices:check && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:release-qa: npm run test:release-qa:unit && npm run test:long-run-harness
scripts.qa:release: npm run qa:release:deterministic && npm run qa:release:ai
